capabilities: Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or Antigravity CLIs as vault AI collaborators
Chat with agents in a sidebar with file mentions and image attachments
Apply reviewed AI inline edits to selected note text
Sync vault with GitHub via pull, push, and idle commits
Publish notes to Feishu, Tencent Docs, WeChat drafts, and social platforms
extras: Freemium: article-to-social workbench, browser handoff, and Knowledge Brain require a paid Creator membership; local chat and inline editing are free. Knowledge Brain entry points are hidden in this build. No client-side telemetry; update checks read the GitHub Release manifest.
problem: Obsidian cannot drive local agent CLIs as in-vault assistants, nor publish notes to WeChat, Feishu, Tencent Docs, and Chinese social platforms.

relations.evidence: Knowledge Brain is an opt-in local knowledge workflow powered by claude-obsidian.

requires.name: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or Antigravity CLI

summary: Local AI collaborator plugin that runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Antigravity CLIs with sidebar chat, inline editing, GitHub sync, and publishing.
